Each fiscal year is taken from the 10-K filed two years later (or the FY2025 10-K for FY2024 and FY2025), so later reclassifications are reflected. The first-filed value is compared with the value used in the Sources sheet.
Each year-end is taken from the 10-K for the following year (the FY2025 10-K for FY2025), i.e. the later comparative column.
IS: three-month column of each 10-Q. BS: period-end balance of each 10-Q. CF: fiscal year-to-date column of each 10-Q (Q1 = 3 months, Q2 = 6 months, Q3 = 9 months).
Income-statement expenses are shown positive as filed (cost of goods sold, SG&A, interest expense, income taxes). Cash-flow outflows are negative as filed.
FY2016-FY2018 filings present a discontinued-operations line (FY2017-FY2018). The latest filing presenting each year is used, so FY2017 and FY2018 follow the FY2019 and FY2020 10-K presentation.

Later 10-Ks recast earlier years: FY2016 operating income (FY2018 10-K), FY2017 and FY2018 net operating revenues and operating income (FY2019 and FY2020 10-Ks), and operating cash flow for FY2016-FY2018. FY2016 is on the older pre-recast basis because no later 10-K presents it; FY2016-to-FY2017 growth rates therefore mix bases. The differences are listed in the Sources sheet; the cause is not analysed here.

FY2021 onward: 'prepaid expenses and other current assets', 'other noncurrent assets/liabilities' replace earlier captions; debt issuance/payment captions were renamed in the FY2023 10-K with identical values. Equivalent lines share one row.

KO re-segmented in the FY2019 10-K (Global Ventures added) and again in the FY2025 10-K (Global Ventures dissolved). Segment series are not stitched across bases. The FY2025 10-K recast covers FY2023-FY2025 only.

Large FY2024 'Other operating charges' and FY2024-FY2025 cash-flow movements relate to the IRS tax litigation deposit and the settlement of the fairlife contingent consideration (see 10-K notes). The workbook does not adjust them.
BS Detail, Note Schedules, Operating Metrics
Not built: footnote disaggregation (debt, intangibles, tax) and operating KPIs such as unit case volume are in the 10-K MD&A and notes but were not extracted into time series in this pass.
Not built: KO's comparable (non-GAAP) measures are in the 8-K earnings releases and IR schedules acquired in the research package; they are not included here.
4Q2024 and 4Q2025 are not filed as separate statements and are not derived here; quarterly year-over-year rows are therefore omitted.
Data-preparation workbook only. No investment thesis, valuation, target price or recommendation.
